task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, then get AAPL’s current price in EUR and its latest quote snapshot. After that, send that AAPL quote snapshot to me in the app with high priority, analyze the text “AAPL: 170.25 USD @ yahoo_native,” check my active investment account balance status, and then save a snapshot of the market-watch workspace and alert me in the app with high priority.

user_input.query: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, then get the current price for AAPL in EUR and its latest quote snapshot. After that, send that AAPL quote snapshot to me in the app on channel app with high priority for user_id user_01. Also analyze this text exactly: “AAPL: 170.25 USD @ yahoo_native,” then check the balance status of my active investment account. Finally, save a snapshot of the market-watch workspace at /workspaces/market-watch using the backup name aapl-monitor-session, and alert me in the app with high priority when that’s done.
